witness.requiredPositiveFirst: The unchanged empty root equals its pinned SHA-256 literal.
witness.primary: The next literal empty-input leaf hash assertion differs when the leaf prefix becomes 0x01. The candidate must retain this as a direct literal assertion; expected hashes must not come from AMC functions.
witness.laterSensitive: Other leaf/node/root literal vectors, independent roots, adapter/frontier and proof checks may also fail; classify actual first assertions rather than predicting a total.

maskingExclusions: A generated expected leaf/root using the mutated AMC hash functions would mask domain separation.
Do not stop at empty-root success: that calculation is unchanged.

witness.requiredPositiveFirst: With independently computed L0/L1 and H(0x01||L0||L1), verifyInclusion(index=0,size=2,proof=[L1]) is true.
witness.primary: In the same standalone test, reuse exactly that leaf, proof and root with size=3 and require false. The source walk ends with sn=1, so its terminal completeness refusal is decisive.
witness.laterSensitive: Missing-path cases and direct inclusionSides checks may also be sensitive; inspect actual reached assertions and masked later statements.

maskingExclusions: Do not put direct inclusionSides(...).toBeNull before the standalone verifyInclusion wrong-size assertion.
Do not claim every alternate size must fail: some different declared sizes yield the same path shape, which proof hashes alone cannot distinguish.

futureProtocol: Root admits one operator at a time only in its owned, bound clean fresh copy; source TS only, without rebuilding compiled output.

Run unchanged canonical argv and literal test inventory; retain raw observer/log/process closure and actual failures.
